description: Hardware-agnostic machine learning infrastructure for .NET. Implements high-performance neural network layers in C# that transpile to WebGPU, CUDA, OpenCL, and WebGL via SpawnDev.ILGPU. Optimized for Blazor WebAssembly and native GPU execution.
releaseNotes: v5.3.21 - Text to 3D without the dark dots in thin armour: NarrowBandRemesher + MeshDistanceGrid port the reference's to_glb(remesh=True) (the mesh is rebuilt as a closed shell by narrow-band dual contouring) and the texture bake reads colour at the nearest point of the original mesh (Trellis2Options.Remesh, default on). v5.3.20 - Assets.AssetGenerator (prompt to rigged, animated 3D character on CUDA / OpenCL / WebGPU: FLUX.2 klein or SD-Turbo, RMBG-1.4, TRELLIS.2, SkinTokens, Kimodo) with Examples 07 (console) and 08 (WPF); FLUX.2 8-bit weights and 768 / 1024 px pictures (tiled VAE); RigCleanup removes hand-to-hip skin slivers; text to 3D keeps 300k triangles by default (150k ate thin armour shells). v5.3.19 - Flux2Pipeline.KeepTransformerResident + cached prompt embeddings (further pictures of a prompt in ~8 s instead of ~75 s in a browser), HumanoidRetargeter arm clearance (upper arms swung away from the body; demo selector, default 8 degrees). v5.3.18 - FLUX.2 klein 4B text to image (SpawnDev.ILGPU.ML.Flux2: Flux2Pipeline, Qwen2Tokenizer, Flux2TextEncoder, Flux2Transformer, 4-bit Flux2Weights; gated stage by stage against diffusers, 29 dB from the bf16 reference picture, 2.6 GB of weights on the GPU at a time, runs on CUDA and in the browser on WebGPU) with RunManyAsync (several seeds of one prompt); the text-to-3D demo draws with FLUX.2 klein by default and can draw 4 or 8 pictures for you to pick from. Weights: LostBeard/FLUX.2-klein-4B-q4-ILGPU (Apache-2.0). v5.3.17 - Fix: WebGPU device lost ("A valid external Instance reference no longer exists") drawing with SD Turbo on stable Chrome 145-151: byte-cap drains on WebGPU now wait for the GPU instead of only submitting, and BackgroundRemovalPipeline gains ReleaseWorkingMemory() so a model run between two draws does not keep its feature maps parked. v5.3.16 - Humanoid animation: SpawnDev.ILGPU.ML.Animation plays NVIDIA Kimodo motion clips on a SkinTokens-rigged character (HumanoidMapper finds the body by the shape of the bone tree, HumanoidRetargeter retargets in world space with rest alignment, AnimatedGlb writes glTF animations; matches the reference script to 4e-8). The Image to 3D demo gets an Animate button with 22 preset moves, an in-place toggle and Download animated .glb, and its viewer now skins on the GPU and plays glTF animations. v5.3.15 - Auto-rigging: SkinTokensRigger gives a generated character a skeleton and learned skin weights in one pass (VAST AI SkinTokens, MIT, re-implemented on ILGPU; 5.8 s on CUDA, runs in the browser on WebGPU; 295/296 tokens identical to the PyTorch reference, skin weights 5.7e-5), UniRigRigger is the smaller skeleton + skinning-prior alternative, and the Image to 3D demo has a Rig this model button. v5.3.14 - TRELLIS.2 meshes are cleaned up before they are simplified and unwrapped (MeshRepair, on by default: non-manifold edges, winding, small holes, floating fragments). v5.3.13 -Browser storage is not capped at 10 GB: Chrome's navigator.storage.estimate() reports usage + 10 GiB, not a limit (BrowserStorageEstimate, RangeStreamModelSource plans every file for the cache and falls back to streaming only when the browser really refuses a write). v5.3.12 -SentencePiece honours the GGUF tokenizer.ggml.add_space_prefix flag (Gemma 2/3 multi-turn chat fixed: no stray space token at turn boundaries). v5.3.11 -Image and text to 3D (TRELLIS.2: photo or prompt -> PBR GLB) on CUDA (tensor cores), OpenCL, CPU and in the browser on WebGPU (portable tiled GEMM + flash attention, device mesh clustering, checkpoint streaming / per-file OPFS caching, background pipeline builds). Face detection and recognition (YuNet + SFace, matched against OpenCV). Requires SpawnDev.ILGPU 5.3.8. See CHANGELOG.md.
